risks.description: Limited internet connectivity in rural areas may reduce platform adoption and usability
risks.mitigation: Implement offline-first architecture, data compression, USSD fallback, and progressive web app capabilities

risks.description: Resistance to digital adoption from healthcare workers and facilities
risks.mitigation: Comprehensive training programs, stakeholder engagement, pilot testing, user-centred design

risks.description: Data privacy and security breaches compromising patient information
risks.mitigation: End-to-end encryption, role-based access control, regular security audits, compliance with Uganda Data Protection Act

risks.description: Interoperability challenges with existing healthcare systems
risks.mitigation: Adopt HL7/FHIR standards, provide integration SDKs, API-first architecture, partner engagement

risks.description: Project funding constraints may impact scope or timeline
risks.mitigation: Phased delivery approach, prioritise core functionality, secure government and donor funding

risks.description: Regulatory changes affecting healthcare data handling or telemedicine
risks.mitigation: Engage regulators early, build flexible compliance framework, regular legal review

risks.description: Insufficient GIS data quality for routing and facility location
risks.mitigation: Ground-truthing validation, community mapping partnerships, leverage OpenStreetMap

risks.description: Cybersecurity threats, including ransomware and data breaches, targeting national health infrastructure
risks.mitigation: Defense-in-depth security architecture, 24/7 security operations monitoring, regular penetration testing, documented incident response plan, cyber insurance

risks.description: Attrition of key technical personnel (architects, GIS specialists, security leads) during the project lifecycle
risks.mitigation: Competitive retention packages, thorough knowledge documentation, cross-training, succession planning, partnerships with local universities for talent pipeline

risks.description: Over-dependence on third-party vendors (cloud, payment, mapping) creating lock-in or service-continuity risk
risks.mitigation: Multi-vendor strategy where feasible, contractual SLAs, data portability requirements, defined exit clauses in vendor contracts

risks.description: Poor data quality and migration errors when importing legacy paper-based or fragmented digital records
risks.mitigation: Pre-migration data quality audits, phased data validation, dedicated data migration team, tested rollback procedures
